tagline: Old Floor Out. Slab Ready. Orlando & the Space Coast.

team_members.name: Kalani Manley
team_members.bio: Kalani runs the machine. Twelve years pulling tile, hardwood, laminate, vinyl and commercial glue-down carpet out of Central Florida homes and buildings — and the person who walks your job and quotes it is the same person you will find on the ride-on scraper the morning it starts. That is the whole point of a family shop.

why_choose_us.title: The owner is on the machine
why_choose_us.description: The person who quotes your job is the person running the scraper. No sales rep, no subcontracted crew you have never met, no phone tree. Twelve years, one set of hands.

why_choose_us.title: We fight the dust, not just the tile
why_choose_us.description: Ripping 200 square feet of ceramic loose makes over a hundred pounds of silica dust. We run shrouded, vacuum-fed equipment and we seal the rooms we are not in, because the dust is what you actually live with afterwards.

why_choose_us.title: Removal is the whole job, not a side hustle
why_choose_us.description: Most flooring companies treat demo as the annoying part before the money. It is all we do. That is why we are faster at it, and why installers keep calling us back.

why_choose_us.title: Orlando to the Atlantic
why_choose_us.description: Orlando, Windermere, Merritt Island, Cocoa Beach and Rockledge. Beach condos, Windermere estates, occupied offices — we have taken floors out of all of them.

gallery.title: Checkerboard tile, coming up
gallery.alt: Ride-on floor scraper lifting black and white checkerboard tile in an Orlando kitchen
gallery.description: Ride-on scraper under a chandelier, taking a black-and-white checkerboard floor down to slab in one pass.

gallery.title: Ceramic tile, room by room
gallery.alt: Kalani Manley in respirator and hearing protection breaking up ceramic tile with a ride-on scraper
gallery.description: Respirator, ears, gloves, and a bin staged in the room. Cream ceramic breaking clean off the slab.

gallery.title: Wood-look porcelain, stripped
gallery.alt: Ride-on scraper removing dark wood-look porcelain plank tile down a hallway
gallery.description: Wood-look plank porcelain is some of the most stubborn tile there is. This is what it looks like losing.

gallery.title: Commercial carpet, no downtime
gallery.alt: Ride-on scraper rolling up glue-down commercial carpet along an office corridor
gallery.description: Glue-down commercial broadloom peeling off a corridor in strips. Offices do not get to close for this.

gallery.title: Oceanfront slab prep
gallery.alt: Grinding and vacuum dust extraction on a bare condo slab with the Atlantic visible through the sliders
gallery.description: Vacuum-fed grinder taking the last of the adhesive off an oceanfront condo slab. Ready to cover.

gallery.title: Great room, floor out
gallery.alt: Two-story great room with a coffered wood ceiling and the flooring removed to bare slab
gallery.description: Coffered ceiling, arched windows, and a floor that had to come out without touching any of it.

gallery.title: Entry and threshold
gallery.alt: Hand-carved arched wood front door with tile removed cleanly at the threshold
gallery.description: A hand-carved door you do not get to scratch. Tile out to the threshold, jamb untouched.

gallery.title: Double-door entry, ready
gallery.alt: Open black double front doors of an Orlando home with the entry floor cleared
gallery.description: Doors open, mat down, floor cleared. The house is still liveable while we work.

services_section.heading_lead: We take the old floor out.
services_section.subtitle: Tile, hardwood, laminate, vinyl, commercial carpet, drywall and kitchen cabinets — removed clean, hauled off, and the slab left flat enough for whatever goes down next.

closing_cta.headline: Send us a photo of your floor
closing_cta.body: Twelve years of flooring removal and interior demolition across Orlando, Windermere, Merritt Island, Cocoa Beach and Rockledge. Free quotes, no obligation — text or email a photo of the floor and the square footage and you will get a real number back.
